newsitem.title: UK: UK employment prospects best for 7 years - survey.
newsitem.headline: UK employment prospects best for 7 years - survey.

text.p: British employment prospects for the second quarter of this year are at their best level since 1990, according to a survey of UK employers conducted by The Sunday Times newspaper and Manpower Workwatch.
The poll of 2,028 employers showed 26 percent expect to increase employment over the next three months, while only 12 percent expect to shed staff.
The positive balance of 14 percent is the strongest second-quarter figure since 1990, the newspaper said.
A positive balance of 19 percent of manufacturing companies said they planned to increase staff despite recent concern about the net effects of the strong pound on exporters, The Sunday Times said.
The paper said the survey also suggests skill shortages are starting to emerge.
A regional breakdown showed employers in all areas plan to increase jobs, with the West and East Midlands and the south leading the way.
The latest official statistics showed a 68,200 drop in the number of jobless in February to 6.2 percent of the workforce.
